page-layout: full
description: "Screenshots of one demo document in the four presets of the mcanouil extension, as an HTML page, a Reveal.js deck and a PDF report, with links to each full render."
---

The site renders one demo document for each preset, in the three formats of the extension.
All the demos use the same text, so you can compare the presets on the same content.
The site renders the demos and takes these screenshots each time that it is published.

Select a preset tab to see its HTML page, its Reveal.js deck and its PDF report side by side.
Each card has a link to the full render.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## gold

Editorial: small capitals, gilded rules and warm boxes with a thin gold edge.
The fonts are Source Serif 4 and Fira Code, and the motif is Facets.
[Read the source of this demo on GitHub](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-mcanouil/blob/main/docs/_demos/gold.qmd).

::: {.grid}

## mono

Swiss: graphite on white, blue links, upper case H2 under a rule and square corners.
The fonts are Alegreya Sans and Fira Code, and the motif is Steps.
[Read the source of this demo on GitHub](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-mcanouil/blob/main/docs/_demos/mono.qmd).

## quarto

Documentation: pill tags, callouts framed in their colour and an accent bar beside headings.
The fonts are Alegreya Sans and Fira Code, and the motif is Ribbon.
[Read the source of this demo on GitHub](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-mcanouil/blob/main/docs/_demos/quarto.qmd).

## terminal

Console: a `$` prompt on titles, `[ ]` around kickers and dashed callout frames.
The font is JetBrains Mono, and the motif is Dot field.
This preset is dark only.
[Read the source of this demo on GitHub](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-mcanouil/blob/main/docs/_demos/terminal.qmd).

::: {.grid}
